chars.JOHN: JOHN: an older man wearing a bright red Hawaiian shirt with big white flowers, unbuttoned over a white tank top, white linen trousers, dark aviator sunglasses and a thick gold chain.
chars.GREGORY: GREGORY: a middle-aged man wearing round black glasses, a light blue polo shirt, beige cargo shorts and brown sandals.
chars.GUARD: GUARD: a tall bodyguard wearing a black tactical vest over a black t-shirt, black cargo trousers, black cap and combat boots, holding a pump shotgun pointed at the ground.
chars.COP: COP: a police officer wearing a khaki short-sleeve uniform shirt with dark green epaulettes, dark green trousers, a dark green peaked cap and a black duty belt.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night at a big luxury beach villa on a tropical island in Belize, palm trees, string lights, a pool. JOHN raises a drink on the terrace, laughing loudly, while several party guests (simple figures in colorful summer dresses) arrive through the gate. Wild party mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A sandy street of a small Caribbean beach town in front of the villa gate. GUARD stands aggressively in the middle, shouting at two frightened tourists with backpacks who step back with raised hands. Tense daytime scene.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Outside a modest neighbor house next to the villa. GUARD points angrily at GREGORY's house, ordering him to go away; GREGORY stands on his porch with his arms out, shocked and angry. Evening light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, GREGORY sits on the edge of his bed in his small bedroom, hands pressed over his ears, exhausted and furious, through the window the neighboring villa is glowing with party lights and three big guard dogs bark behind a fence.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the villa garden. JOHN kneels in shock beside three big dogs lying still asleep on the grass near an empty food bowl, GUARD stands behind him looking around suspiciously. Sad, tense mood, no blood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Early morning outside GREGORY's small beach house: yellow police tape across the porch, blue and red police lights reflecting on the walls, the front door half open. COP stands at the tape talking on a radio, serious face. No body visible, no blood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: COP stands in a sandy street writing in a notebook while questioning a worried neighbor woman (simple figure in a yellow dress) at her doorstep; in the background the big villa with tall walls. Suspicious mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: COP and two other police officers in the same khaki uniforms knock hard on the big closed wooden gate of the luxury villa, one shining a flashlight. Dusk, palm trees, no answer, tense.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the villa's big living room after the front door was forced open (broken door hanging). COP stands in the middle shining a flashlight around the empty room: an abandoned half-eaten meal on the table, an open empty suitcase, curtains blowing at an open window. Nobody else is there. Mysterious mood.
